// Generated by pw from `store.pricing`. Do not edit.
// ADR-0015: the pure subset only. Every function declares `total`,
// because Koka's exhaustiveness check is vacuous under any other row.
module store_pricing

pub value struct cart_line
  quantity : int
  unit_price : int

pub type order_state
  Draft
  Pricing
  Confirmed( field0 : string )

pub fun line_total( line : cart_line ) : total int
  (line.quantity * line.unit_price)

pub fun with_delivery( subtotal : int, distance_m : int ) : total int
  val base = 299
  val surcharge = if (distance_m > 5000) then
    200
  else
    0
  ((subtotal + base) + surcharge)

pub fun label( state : order_state ) : total string
  match state
    Draft -> "draft"
    Pricing -> "pricing"
    Confirmed( reference ) -> reference
